name: Chapter 1: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants
description: Anther, pollen, ovule, embryo sac, pollination, double fertilisation, endosperm, embryo, seed, fruit and apomixis

name: Chapter 2: Human Reproduction
description: Male and female reproductive systems, gametogenesis, menstrual cycle, fertilisation, implantation, pregnancy, parturition and lactation

name: Chapter 3: Reproductive Health
description: Reproductive health programmes, population and contraception, MTP, sexually transmitted infections, infertility and ART

name: Chapter 4: Principles of Inheritance and Variation
description: Mendel’s laws, incomplete and co-dominance, linkage, polygenic traits, pleiotropy, sex determination, mutation and genetic disorders

name: Chapter 5: Molecular Basis of Inheritance
description: DNA structure and packaging, search for genetic material, replication, transcription, genetic code, translation, lac operon, HGP and DNA fingerprinting

name: Chapter 6: Evolution
description: Origin of life, Darwinism, evidences, adaptive radiation, mechanism, Hardy-Weinberg, history of life and human evolution

name: Chapter 7: Human Health and Disease
description: Common diseases and pathogens, malaria life cycle, immunity, vaccines, allergy, lymphoid organs, AIDS, cancer and drug abuse

name: Chapter 8: Microbes in Human Welfare
description: Microbes in household foods, industrial products, antibiotics, sewage treatment, biogas, biocontrol and biofertilisers

name: Chapter 9: Biotechnology: Principles and Processes
description: Genetic engineering principles, restriction enzymes, gel electrophoresis, vectors, competent hosts, PCR, bioreactors and downstream processing

name: Chapter 10: Biotechnology and its Applications
description: Tissue culture, GM crops, Bt cotton, RNAi, recombinant insulin, gene therapy, molecular diagnosis, transgenic animals and biopiracy

name: Chapter 11: Organisms and Populations
description: Population attributes, density, growth models, life history, and interactions: predation, competition, parasitism, commensalism, mutualism
